doc.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Learning four languages at school
summary: After twelve years of school he knew French, Flemish, English and German, helped by American movies.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: So Flemish, French, and English or…

But later on, when I start to travel. But in school, in those days when you went to école moyenne, they called it. It takes twelve years. You have six years elementary and then six years secondary, right? And my direction was mathematics and languages. So at age… after twelve years of school, I could speak… We had good English teachers, good German. So the four languages were French, Flemish, English, and German. So when I was sixteen, I could write business letters in English and in German. And of course, by then, the movies, you know… James Cagney and all those. So I learned English, you know, real quick.
